name: funkey-os
description: FunKey-OS 2.3.0 (FunKey S retro handheld): a BR2_EXTERNAL tree on the FunKey fork of Buildroot 2021.02, external musl toolchain, 32-bit ARM
notes: Buildroot 2021.02 predates glibc 2.34 (host-m4 does not build on a current host), and the released FunKey SDK's .la files name /opt/FunKey-sdk-2.1.0, where upstream installs it: the project names the `funkey` tool baseline (ubuntu 20.04 plus that SDK at that path; legacy worker pool, same image for the golden Job). No patches are applied.
patches/external/0001: PCSX-ReARMed's install runs mksquashfs without depending on host-squashfs; per-package directories need the dependency declared. Nothing in the image changes.
